items.description:
## What's Changed
### Kimi CLI
You can now install and run the Kimi CLI through Ollama.

```
ollama launch kimi --model kimi-k2.6:cloud
```
Kimi CLI with Kimi K2.6 excels at long horizon agentic execution tasks through a multi-agent system.
